verdict.rationale: The evidence documents pull-request review and merging, plus GitHub Actions-compatible CI workflows. Nothing in the pack shows branch protection, required status checks, or any way to block a merge until custom quality or compliance checks pass. CI workflows are only a building block toward enforced merge gates, not the enforcement capability itself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce custom quality and compliance merge checks on pull requests
